about: Every point where the mod reads or changes Skyrim. Each row becomes one Hook enum value and table entry; Hooks.cpp must handle every value (a switch with no default). 'verified' turns true only after the running game proved it, with 'evidence' saying how.

columns.api: the CommonLib / Win32 call it uses
columns.thread: main (game thread, from an event sink) | worker (the mod's own thread) | any
columns.purpose: what the mod uses it for
columns.verified: true once seen working in the running game
columns.evidence: log line or screenshot that proved it; empty until verified

rows.api: DllMain (.asi via Ultimate ASI Loader) -> thread waits for RE::UI::GetSingleton()
rows.purpose: start without SKSE on any game version Melty supports
rows.evidence: 2026-10-07 Skyrim 1.7.104: MojaveInSkyrim.asi loaded by Ultimate ASI Loader v9.7.4 from the release zip; log 'hook asi_boot ok: UI is up'

rows.api: RE::UI MenuOpenCloseEvent sink: Main Menu opening (all plugins loaded), retried on later menu events
rows.purpose: know when forms are loaded, then resolve the music type table and install the input sink
rows.evidence: log 'hook data_loaded ok: forms are loaded (Main Menu menu event, attempt 1)' on every launch since the Main Menu fix

rows.purpose: turn skyrim_music_types rows into runtime form IDs
rows.evidence: log 'hook music_types ok: 64 of 64 sheet music types resolved'

rows.api: RE::BSMusicManager::GetSingleton()->current, skyrim_cast<RE::BGSMusicType*> (not a form = Skyrim's internal NoMusic)
rows.purpose: which music Skyrim wants right now; sampled every frame on the game thread (the worker only reads the snapshot: Skyrim frees music objects during loads)
rows.evidence: log 'MUSExploreTundra -> pool desert', 'MUSExploreForestPine -> mountain', 'MUSCombatBossChargen -> boss', 'MUSSpecialCart -> title', NoMusic -> title at main menu; 5 save loads with no exit after moving reads to the game thread

rows.purpose: silence Skyrim's music without touching the saved Music slider; restore for story moments (worker asks, game thread applies)
rows.evidence: log 'hook music_mute: Skyrim's music muted'; only New Vegas music heard in the recorded clip

rows.purpose: follow the player's Master and Music volume sliders
rows.evidence: log volume line followed the player's Music slider 0.50 -> 0.65 during play

rows.purpose: pick New Vegas day or night tracks
rows.evidence: log hour 2.6-5.6 -> _Night_ tracks (DesExpl_Night, Mountain_Night); hour 8 -> _Day_ track

rows.purpose: radio toggle and volume keys; runs every frame, so it also takes the game-state snapshot and shows queued notices
rows.evidence: 0.2.0: N toggles (log 'radio on/off'); = and - step the radio 110%..10% in 10% steps with HUD notice (log 'radio volume N%'); level saved to MojaveInSkyrim.user.ini and reloaded at next start (log 'radio volume 0.20 from ...user.ini'); sink runs every frame (600/600 empty calls)

rows.api: RE::UI::GetSingleton()->GameIsPaused(), IsMenuOpen(Console); Main Menu open/close events
rows.purpose: ignore the radio key while menus or the console are open; know when the main menu is up
rows.evidence: player test 2026-10-07 on 0.2.0: Esc menu open + N did nothing, N after closing toggled; NoMusic at main menu -> title via Main Menu events
screenshots/clip: 'Radio New Vegas: on' and 'Radio New Vegas: Ain't That a Kick in the Head' HUD notices (_media/courier6-radio.png)

rows.purpose: fade out while Skyrim is in the background
rows.evidence: log 'hook focus: Skyrim isn't the active window; fading out' then 'is the active window; fading in' when another window took focus

rows.api: AddVectoredExceptionHandler + MiniDumpWriteDump (dbghelp) for faults inside MojaveInSkyrim.asi
rows.purpose: leave a log line and a minidump if the mod ever faults
rows.evidence: handler installed (log 'hook crash_log ok'); no fault occurred in any test since, so nothing to catch
